caseNameFull: Byrne, District Attorney of Suffolk County v. Karalexis
attorneys: Stanley Fleishman and Sam Rosenwein for National General Corp. et al., and Thomas R. Asher, Michael Schneiderman, and Melvin L. Wulj for American Civil Liberties Union et al. on the motions.

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. Mass. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 985.] Motions of National General Corp. et al. and American Civil Liberties Union et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
